MY APPROACH

Understanding the system.
Building the details.

I’m a mechanical engineering student who learns by turning equations into things I can build and measure. Robotics gives me a reason to connect the mechanism, the circuit, and the code.

My projects document what I designed, what I tested, and what I’m still working to understand.

01 / SYSTEMS REASONING

Follow the whole problem.

I trace issues across mechanical interfaces, wiring, coordinate conventions, and control software.

02 / MEASURED ITERATION

Let tests guide the revision.

Actuator prototypes and bench tests inform changes to bearings, clearances, geometry, and manufacturing.

03 / TECHNICAL COLLABORATION

Make the work understandable.

I document assumptions and help teammates take ownership of small, testable subsystems.
